Vaticana jam parabantur fulmina: Noaillius ab ipso Cardinalium Collegio purpura indignus censebatur. But since all my studies, by doing well for many, have fallen into ruin, I cannot be sufficiently satisfied. You know well enough what benefits and services our fellow citizens have received from me. How ungrateful they have been toward me, time itself has taught. For when those men whom I had made my friends for the sake of our common salvation had turned against me, and had instigated judges and prepared false witnesses against me, who was there to defend my rights? Or who was willing to protect my dignity? But I feel that it happens with good reason that I experience them as ungrateful, in whose love for me there was no rationale.
